label: preparing
what: A coordinated great-hall gathering with substantial bread refreshments and eight lanterns, publicly described to me as civic hospitality. The concealed purpose may be a celebration of my forty years as mayor, but that is only a suspicion, not confirmed. Innkeeper organizes private refreshments, builder provides lighting, freight apparently transports bread; secretary coordinates the reservation and my escort, and baker supplies bread, though neither helper's knowledge of any surprise is established.
